title: Commutative-ring presentation of the smooth-purity coefficient tower
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $O$, and a scheme $T$. Use the quotient sheaves and reduction maps of [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers]. Define the commutative-ring coefficient tower $B_\bullet$ to be the functor from $\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}}$ to sheaves of commutative rings on $T_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$ with $B_n=(O/\ell^n)_T$ and adjacent transition $a\bmod\ell^{n+1}\mapsto a\bmod\ell^n$. All other transitions are composites and identities. Its underlying ring-sheaf tower is the coefficient ring tower of that definition. In the Lean indexing, natural index $n$ denotes exponent $n+1$.
